answer.zh: 陈曦是西北工业大学软件工程专业本科生，最初学习数学与统计，后来转向计算机。主要关注视觉语言模型、视觉语言动作模型与自主智能体，预计 2027 年前往北京大学计算机学院攻读博士学位。
answer.en: Chen Xi is an undergraduate in Software Engineering at Northwestern Polytechnical University, originally from Mathematics and Statistics. He works on VLMs, VLAs, and autonomous agents, and expects to begin a PhD at Peking University’s School of Computer Science in 2027.

answer.zh: 陈曦目前公开的研究兴趣包括多模态异常检测、具身智能，以及面向数据分析的智能体框架。他尤其关注 VLM、VLA 与能长期规划、执行和复盘的自主智能体。
answer.en: Chen currently publishes three main research interests: multimodal anomaly detection, embodied AI, and agent frameworks for data analysis. His broader focus is on VLMs, VLAs, and autonomous agents that can plan, execute, and review longer-running work.

answer.zh: 陈曦在西北工业大学学习软件工程，最初的专业方向是数学与统计。2026 年 9 月推免结束，预计 2027 年进入北京大学计算机学院攻读博士学位。比起证明定理，他更喜欢把想法做成能运行的东西。
answer.en: Chen studies Software Engineering at Northwestern Polytechnical University after starting in Mathematics and Statistics. His graduate admissions process wrapped up in September 2026, and he expects to start a PhD at Peking University’s School of Computer Science in 2027. Building things turned out to be more his thing than proving theorems.

answer.zh: 公开经历按开始时间排列：2025—2026 年，在西北工业大学空天地海一体化系统实验室随吴鹏教授开展研究；2026 年 1—6 月，在浙江大学 ZJUNLP 随张宁豫老师担任 RA；2026 年 3—4 月，在清华大学某非计算机学院担任 RA；预计 2027 年进入北京大学计算机学院攻读博士学位。
answer.en: In chronological order: research at NPU’s Air-Space-Ground-Sea Integrated Systems Laboratory with Prof. Peng Wu in 2025–2026; an RA at ZJUNLP, Zhejiang University, with Prof. Ningyu Zhang from January to June 2026; an RA at a non-CS school at Tsinghua University from March to April 2026; and an expected PhD start at Peking University’s School of Computer Science in 2027.

answer.zh: 陈曦目前公开表示正在寻找科研或工程方向的实习，尤其关注能够把有用想法落地为工作系统的岗位。
answer.en: Chen is currently looking for research or engineering internships, especially roles where useful ideas can become working systems.

answer.zh: 2026 年 9 月推免结束啦！陈曦预计 2027 年前往北京大学计算机学院攻读博士学位。关于未来导师，他想公开说的就是：我超爱我的导师！！！
answer.en: Graduate admissions wrapped up in September 2026! Chen expects to start a PhD at Peking University’s School of Computer Science in 2027. His public message about his future advisor: “I absolutely love my advisor!”

answer.zh: 北京大学的导师姓名暂不公开，但有一句话必须说：我超爱我的导师！！！
answer.en: Chen is keeping his Peking University advisor’s name private for now. But this part is very public: “I absolutely love my advisor!”

answer.zh: 最近在尝试做自媒体，幻想成为 vlogger，也在找实习、折腾各种有意思的东西。简历还在迭代优化，欢迎来找我玩！
answer.en: Lately: making content, daydreaming about becoming a vlogger, looking for internships, and trying all sorts of fun things. The résumé is still a work in progress. Come say hi — I’m always up for something interesting!

answer.zh: 最近两条动态：2026 年 9 月，推免结束，预计 2027 年前往北京大学计算机学院攻读博士学位；2026 年 10 月，获得国家奖学金。
answer.en: Two recent updates: graduate admissions wrapped up in September 2026, with an expected PhD start at Peking University’s School of Computer Science in 2027; in October 2026, Chen received the National Scholarship.

answer.zh: 公开 Portfolio 目前包含五个项目：Argus、LabVLA、MiniMax-H3 Desktop Edition、IronRock Desktop Pet，以及风电预测性维护项目“风调预顺”。
answer.en: The public portfolio currently contains five projects: Argus, LabVLA, MiniMax-H3 Desktop Edition, IronRock Desktop Pet, and the “风调预顺” wind-turbine predictive-maintenance project.

answer.zh: Argus 是陈曦参与的自主智能体项目，关注长任务中的规划、执行、审查与恢复。他在公开介绍中将自己的工作概括为同时参与研究与工程。
answer.en: Argus is an autonomous-agent project Chen contributes to, focused on planning, execution, review, and resumption across long-running tasks. His public description says he works across both research and engineering.

answer.zh: LabVLA 是陈曦参与的科学实验室 VLA 项目。它以 Qwen3-VL 为视觉语言骨干，并结合 DiT flow-matching 动作专家，把实验协议、视觉观测与机器人状态连接到连续动作。
answer.en: LabVLA is a scientific-laboratory VLA project Chen worked on. It pairs a Qwen3-VL vision-language backbone with a DiT flow-matching action expert to connect lab protocols, visual observations, and robot state to continuous actions.

answer.zh: MiniMax-H3 Desktop Edition 是一个单 GPU 推理优化项目，目标是在一张 48 GB RTX A6000 上运行完整的音视频生成，并持续优化速度与显存占用。
answer.en: MiniMax-H3 Desktop Edition is a single-GPU inference-optimization project. Its public goal is to run full audio-video generation on one 48 GB RTX A6000 while improving speed and memory use.

answer.zh: IronRock Desktop Pet 是一个 PyQt6 桌面助手项目，可接收 PDF、笔记或日志，整理本地实验室知识库并进行问答。它最初来自一次黑客松。
answer.en: IronRock Desktop Pet is a PyQt6 desktop assistant that accepts PDFs, notes, or logs, organizes a local lab knowledge base, and chats over it. It began as a hackathon project.

answer.zh: “风调预顺”是一个风力发电机预测性维护课程项目，把监控、故障诊断、剩余寿命预测与工单流程整合在一个全栈系统中。
answer.en: “风调预顺” is a course project for wind-turbine predictive maintenance, combining monitoring, fault diagnosis, remaining-useful-life prediction, and work-order flows in one full-stack system.

answer.zh: 陈曦在 2025 年、2026 年 10 月获得国家奖学金。
answer.en: Chen received the National Scholarship in 2025 and again in October 2026.

answer.zh: 主页列出五项工作：基于歧义区域感知与检索增强生成的弱监督视频异常检测方法；LabVLA: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models in Scientific Laboratories；Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Reasoning Runtime for Long-Horizon Tasks；What Should a Data Agent Remember About Its Own Results?；LongInterSQL: Benchmarking Inter-Session Artifact Reuse in Interactive Text-to-SQL。
answer.en: Five works are listed: 基于歧义区域感知与检索增强生成的弱监督视频异常检测方法; LabVLA: Grounding Vision-Language-Action Models in Scientific Laboratories; Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Reasoning Runtime for Long-Horizon Tasks; What Should a Data Agent Remember About Its Own Results?; and LongInterSQL: Benchmarking Inter-Session Artifact Reuse in Interactive Text-to-SQL.

answer.zh: 欢迎来找陈曦聊聊！可以使用主页侧栏的公开邮箱或 GitHub 链接。
answer.en: Come say hi! You can reach Chen through the public email or GitHub links in the profile sidebar.
